results.title: Юрий Бутусов. Барабаны внутри
results.overview: For its creators, this film became, in a sense, a labor of love and duty. *Yuri Butusov: Drums Within* is a film about the director’s talent, his confrontation with reality, his mission, and love. Those featured in the film—Butusov’s students, actors who worked with him, his former classmates, close associates, and his "gang"—were unanimous: knowing and working with him was never, and could never have been, just another project. He changed the people he met and transformed the space around him; he would stir things up and create a swell of energy—making the whole cauldron boil. Yet, often enough, he himself found himself powerless against that very tide. Making a film about such a man—avoiding the trap of turning him into a monument and ensuring the result was anything but banal—was a formidable challenge for the filmmakers. They worked on the project for over a year, gathering a wealth of rare archival material and interviewing dozens of people.

results.title: Recuerdos manchados en color marrón
results.overview: The story follows a father seeking forgiveness as he gives his daughter a beautiful memory during a nostalgic and emotional trip, before she is taken away by a new foster family.

results.title: A Summer of Nothing
results.overview: Filmmaker Alina Manolache arrives on an island in Greece with grand plans to film a documentary on Venus de Milo's repatriation, but the project does not materialise. Finding it impossible to accept the new situation, Alina decides to dissect her obsession for work and achievement, through an experiment of doing the exact opposite: nothing. But is there ever nothing? As she meets Mady, a local woman with a very busy family life, the study of nothing turns into a labyrinthine personal journey.

results.title: Cabaret Boys
results.overview: A fringe therapist takes the world by storm with a galaxy-brained new approach to self-help called the Jackman Method. Through immersive sessions, he transforms wayward young men into semi-employable outsider artists—all from the comfort of his posh home office in New York City. When an unhinged ex-patient returns to his care and is chosen to headline the practice’s first ever cabaret night, the fallout is immense. Diva behavior, grueling rehearsals, and public scandal threaten to destroy not only the show but the Jackman Method itself.

results.title: 12 Gaun 2
results.overview: Two warriors uncover a massive secret conspiracy orchestrated by powerful forces, plunging them into a deadly battle where every truth comes at a price.

results.title: Tiber
results.overview: Marco, an Australian-Italian art historian living in Rome, is quietly let go from his teaching post after grief leaves him distant from his students. He returns to Cortona, where his estranged wife Julia and young daughter Lucia live. Reunited with his old friend Pietro, Marco borrows a vintage golden Fiat X1/9 and embarks with Lucia on a poignant summer road trip toward the Tiber River in Rome, fulfilling a promise he has carried and avoided for years. Traveling through sunlit valleys, ancient hill towns, Florence, and historical landscapes, the father and daughter navigate their tenderness and attempt to find their way back to each other. However, the journey slowly shifts from a simple summer escape into a deep, meditative passage through memory, absence, and the difficult art of letting go.

results.title: My Love For You Is Deep But the Devil Loves Me Deeper
results.original_title: My Love For You Is Deep But the Devil Loves Me Deeper
results.overview: Alice, a young woman shattered by heartbreak after being dumped from her nebbish boyfriend Ryan, encounters the Devil and makes a deal for “all the love in the world.”

results.title: Blood Before Bitcoin
results.overview: Myrna, a former gang member, runs a roadside motel with her younger boyfriend, Floyd. When her old gang arrives for a mysterious Bitcoin heist, buried grudges, jealousy, and betrayal threaten the score- and the new life Myrna fought to build.

results.title: You Can See Everything
results.overview: Thirty-four days before she's sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending three-year journey into the abyss.

results.title: Scars and Splinters
results.overview: A young woman fights for survival against a mysterious botanical infection

results.title: The Name Game
results.overview: Determined to reveal a dark family secret to Jerron, Charlotte plays the cursed name-chanting game her grandmother swore off in the 1950’s South.

results.title: river man
results.overview: As a homeless alcoholic struggles through withdrawal, haunting memories and creeping paranoia blur the line between reality and delusion

results.title: You Can't Leave
results.overview: Searching for a missing friend, a group enters a dark forest and discovers an abandoned cabin concealing an ancient evil. As night falls, they must survive the shadows and uncover the truth before it is too late.

results.title: Where the Rain Nests
results.overview: In a rural town in southern Chile, three teenage friends spend their final months before finishing high school, facing a future that could pull them away from the place where they grew up.

results.title: Wild Mushrooms
results.overview: After the death of an enigmatic TV detective, a curious girl finds refuge in her garden, where she begins to uncover the strange connection between death and her mother’s melancholy.

results.title: The tail of Hans
results.overview: The mermaid finally gains the legs she longed for, but not the gender she expected. Confused and lost, she begins searching for an existence beyond the binary. (World Premiere – International Short Film Competition, 2026 Kaohsiung Film Festival)

results.title: Beyond The Eagle Obsession
results.overview: A companion to "The Eagle Obsession", "Beyond the Eagle Obsession: 50 Years of Fandom” spotlights the passionate collectors, artists, model builders, and fans who have kept the legacy of the Eagle spacecraft alive for half a century.

results.title: La Mujer que soñaba bajo el agua
results.original_title: La Mujer que soñaba bajo el agua
results.overview: Following the sudden death of their third newborn child, the Rangel family takes refuge in their lakeside home. Desperate to escape reality, Olga suffers a psychotic episode and begins to suspect that her husband and children have been replaced by imposters. Convinced that her real family has been abducted, she will stop at nothing to get them back.

results.title: Satanascabaña
results.overview: A group of friends travels to a cabin to celebrate Citlali’s birthday, but she never arrives. Instead, Fernando—a friend of hers whom no one knows—shows up.
